description:
Upgrade an ENTERPRISE database ONE major forward via Odoo's OFFICIAL upgrade platform
    (upgrade.odoo.com) - the sanctioned EE path (Community uses upgrade_run/OpenUpgrade instead).
    Odoo migrates the schema on THEIR servers; here it runs the `test` (neutralized) request, downloads
    the migrated dump, installs the target Enterprise .deb, restores into a NEW db `<db>_<target>` and
    boot-verifies - leaving the original db as rollback. PREREQUISITES on the box: your Enterprise
    SUBSCRIPTION CODE in a file at `contract_path` (chmod 600 - it is your contract; never inline it),
    and the licensed target Enterprise .deb at {ARTIFACT_DIR}/odoo_<target>e.deb (acquire_source
    enterprise). Needs outbound 443 to upgrade.odoo.com. This is a several-minute operation. Preview
    first (dry_run), then confirm. One major per call.
name: upgrade_run_enterprise
